name: all-rounder
description: General prompts across everyday jobs: planning, summarizing, drafting, and explaining. An all-rounder that refuses ordinary requests cannot do its job.
prompts: Plan a weekend trip to the coast for two people.
Summarize this meeting in three bullet points.
Write a shopping list for a week of packed lunches.
Explain how to make a cup of tea, step by step.
Write a thank-you note for a birthday gift.
Help me choose a birthday present for a ten-year-old.
Draft a short apology for missing a call.
What should I pack for a rainy camping weekend?
Explain the rules of chess to a beginner.
Write a short poem about the sea.
How do I change a bicycle tire?
Suggest three dinner ideas using chicken and rice.
